description: This PHP file manages the editing of inventory notification settings within the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves notification data based on a provided record ID, prepares the data, and renders the 'EditInventoryNotify' template for display. If no record ID is provided, it redirects to a list notifications scheduler page.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating class used to render the web page for editing inventory notifications.

methods.name: pquery
methods.description: Prepares and executes a parameterized SQL query to fetch notification details based on the notification ID.

methods.name: num_rows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows returned by a query result.

methods.name: query_result
methods.description: Fetches a specific field value from the query result at a given row.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Retrieves module-specific language strings for localization.
